fields.name: System Administrator
fields.description: Full system access for hospital administrators

fields.name: Medical Doctor
fields.description: Licensed medical practitioner (KMPDB registered). Permanent or employed staff.

fields.name: Consultant
fields.description: External specialist doctor providing consultation services (KMPDB registered). Typically external service provider (ESP).

fields.name: Clinical Officer
fields.description: Licensed clinical officer (COC - Clinical Officers Council registered). Ranks below Medical Doctor but above Nurse.

fields.name: Registered Nurse
fields.description: Licensed nurse (NCK - Nursing Council of Kenya registered)

fields.name: Nurse Aide
fields.description: Nursing assistant providing basic patient care under supervision. Ranks below Nurse but above CHW. No license required.

fields.name: Laboratory Technician
fields.description: Licensed laboratory technician (KMLTTB registered)

fields.name: Pharmacist
fields.description: Licensed pharmacist (PPB - Pharmacy and Poisons Board registered)

fields.name: Receptionist
fields.description: Front desk and patient registration staff

fields.name: Medical Records Clerk
fields.description: Medical records management staff

fields.name: Community Health Worker
fields.description: Community-based health promotion and basic care

fields.name: Billing Clerk
fields.description: Billing, invoicing, and SHA claims processing

fields.name: Radiographer
fields.description: Licensed radiographer operating X-ray, CT, fluoroscopy, and mammography equipment (KRCHRRD - Kenya Radiographers and Clinical Health Records and Data Officers Registration Board registered). Responsible for patient positioning, radiation safety, and image acquisition.

fields.name: Sonographer
fields.description: Licensed sonographer/ultrasonographer specializing in diagnostic ultrasound imaging (KRCHRRD registered). Performs obstetric, abdominal, pelvic, vascular, and musculoskeletal ultrasound examinations.

fields.name: Radiologist
fields.description: Licensed medical doctor specializing in diagnostic and interventional radiology (KMPDB registered). Interprets imaging studies, generates radiology reports, and performs image-guided procedures.

fields.name: Radiology Assistant
fields.description: Entry-level radiology support staff assisting with patient preparation, positioning, and equipment setup. Works under supervision of radiographers. No license required.

fields.name: MRI Technologist
fields.description: Specialized radiographer trained in Magnetic Resonance Imaging (KRCHRRD registered). Operates MRI equipment, ensures patient safety in magnetic environment, and optimizes image quality for various body parts.

fields.name: CT Technologist
fields.description: Specialized radiographer trained in Computed Tomography scanning (KRCHRRD registered). Operates CT equipment, administers contrast media under protocol, and ensures radiation dose optimization.

fields.name: Nuclear Medicine Technologist
fields.description: Specialized technologist handling radioactive materials for diagnostic imaging (KRCHRRD and RPBK registered). Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals, operates gamma cameras, PET/CT scanners, and ensures radiation safety.

fields.name: Physiotherapist
fields.description: Licensed physiotherapist (Kenya Society of Physiotherapists registered). Provides assessment, treatment, and rehabilitation for physical conditions affecting movement and function.

fields.name: Dietitian
fields.description: Licensed dietitian/nutritionist (Kenya Nutritionists and Dietitians Institute registered). Provides nutrition assessment, diet planning, and nutritional counselling for patients.

fields.name: Occupational Therapist
fields.description: Licensed occupational therapist (Kenya Occupational Therapy Association registered). Provides assessment and treatment to help patients participate in daily activities and occupations.

fields.name: Social Worker
fields.description: Licensed medical social worker (Kenya National Association of Social Workers registered). Provides psychosocial assessment, case management, and support services including sensitive case handling (GBV, child protection).

fields.name: Counsellor
fields.description: Licensed counselling professional (Kenya Counselling and Psychological Association registered). Provides individual and group counselling for mental health, HIV/AIDS, substance abuse, and other psychosocial issues.

fields.name: Pharmacy Technologist
fields.description: Licensed pharmacy technologist (PPB registered). Assists pharmacists with dispensing, stock management, and prescription processing.

fields.name: Laboratory Scientist
fields.description: Licensed medical laboratory scientist (KMLTTB registered). Performs and verifies complex laboratory investigations, supervises lab technicians.

fields.name: Pathologist
fields.description: Licensed pathologist (KMPDB registered). Specialist doctor who interprets and verifies laboratory results, performs histopathology, and provides clinical consultation on diagnostic findings.

fields.name: Phlebotomist
fields.description: Trained phlebotomist specializing in venipuncture and specimen collection. Works under supervision of laboratory staff.

fields.name: Cashier
fields.description: Revenue collection and payment processing staff. Handles cash, M-Pesa, card, and bank transfer payments.

fields.name: Billing Supervisor
fields.description: Supervises billing operations including invoice approval, discount authorization, void approvals, and SHA claims oversight.

fields.name: Store Keeper
fields.description: Manages central stores, receiving goods, stock adjustments, and inventory control across pharmacy and general supplies.

fields.name: HR Officer
fields.description: Human resources officer managing staff profiles, onboarding, leave, and personnel records.

fields.name: Compliance Officer
fields.description: Responsible for regulatory compliance, audit log review, data protection (Kenya DPA 2019), and quality assurance oversight.

fields.name: Administrator
fields.description: Organization-level administrator managing facility settings, staff, billing configuration, and operational oversight. Does not access clinical data directly.

fields.name: Department Supervisor
fields.description: Department-level supervisor with oversight of staff, schedules, and departmental operations. Automatically assigned when a staff member is appointed as department head.
